g.title: nvfp4_coldstart
g.text: nvidia/Qwen3-8B-NVFP4 . RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell (24 GB GDDR7)
phase order & bottleneck shown; per-phase wall times are not instrumented in this project

g.title: P2
g.text: vllm / sglang, torch, flashinfer, flash-attn, cutlass

g.title: P4
g.text: driver handshake, primary ctx, cuBLAS / cuDNN handles

g.title: P5
g.text: open safetensors, build per-layer NVFP4 tensor views

g.title: P6
g.text: NVFP4 packed tensors + FP8 scales + BF16 lm_head/embed
over PCIe Gen5 x16 (~55 GB/s practical)

g.title: P7
g.text: bind cutlass NVFP4 GEMM operands, init per-block scale tensors

g.title: P9
g.text: NVFP4 cutlass JIT autotune per (SM, kernel, shape)

g.title: P10
g.text: dummy decode pass, fill cuBLAS workspace, lazy module init

g.title: P11
g.text: router stops polling, proxies queued request
